component.name: OpenRealm
component.summary: Open-source Warcraft III implementation using original game data

description.p: OpenRealm is an open-source implementation of Warcraft III built around a Quake-style engine architecture and SDL.

This package does not contain Blizzard game assets. A legally obtained Warcraft III data folder containing War3.mpq is required. On first launch, OpenRealm asks you to select that folder through the desktop file chooser.

When War3x.mpq is present, the launcher starts the Frozen Throne data set; otherwise it starts Reign of Chaos. Steam Deck users can optionally add a non-Steam shortcut with packaged artwork and a Steam Input gamepad-and-mouse template.
